setup: CREATE TABLE g06_substring AS SELECT CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 'alphabet soup' WHEN 1 THEN 'é🦆x' WHEN 2 THEN 'aé' ELSE '' END AS v, CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN -2 WHEN 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS start, CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 6 WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS count, i % 100 AS unique_start FROM range(50000) t(i)
